invariants: unauthorized update has no task_id and cannot dispatch
intent is atomically committed before DISPATCHED
INTENT_COMMITTED resumes the same task/run after restart
outbox is atomically present before transport attempt
SENDING or uncertain transport outcome is never auto-retried
confirmed message_key is never resent after restart
CLOSED requires RESPONSE_CONFIRMED and disk readback
raw message text is not stored in durable event/outbox records
